reviews.t: My brother and his wife got married in this church back in December 2023. It is so unique and historically beautiful. I am so glad to see they were able to salvage its charm after the hurricane. I highly recommend coming here for Sunday mass if you’re in the area or having a small marriage ceremony at this gem.
Beautiful little community church, well kept. We were on vacation and googled a catholic church, this one came up and was a really nice experience. Great to see these small churches being taken care.

On any visit to the Black Mountain area, we attend mass at St. Margaret Mary Catholic Church in Swannanoa. It is a beautiful small church. Initially, we always had Father Leonard - whom we adored. He was very passionate and had great homolies. Since his passing there have been a couple of other priests. The current priests have a lot more rituals in the mass. We attended the 8:30AM Sunday Mass - it is more a "Latin Mass" where the other masses are probably more traditional.
Beautiful church to get married in. Reverend Cook did an amazing job with the ceremony!

Mike and I are from Tampa, staying at the KOA. We found SMM Church and it was precious. Sunday Mass was wonderful and the church was full!!! I also went on Tuesday to honor my baby, Michelle. Not only did Father stand at the pulpit to tell us how his barber convert others to the Church but even a democrat to a republican. He got one laugh. I was NOT the one laugh. Before the last blessing, he then told us about the 6 Catholic Supreme Court Justices that overturned Roe vs. Wade and highlighted Clarence Thomas. "You've got to be kidding me, Father!!!" Clarence Thomas is NOT a good example of a Catholic or haven't you heard about his sexual assult, harassment and not reporting hugh amounts of gifts!! I don't EVER go to Mass to hear the opinion of a Priest political views. I got up and left before the final blessing. Left very disappointed, tearful and mad, no way to leave Holy Mass !!! Sacred Heart of Jesus I trust in You Tara from Tampa
Beautiful church, wonderful Priest, small community church with a faithful following.

We have fallen in love with this little Parrish. We live in Marshall and are building an additional home in Old Fort. So we decided to find a church near Old Fort that will be more convenient for us. Our search brought us here and we are so thankful. From the processional cross to the kneeling upon receiving of the Eucharist, this Parrish is a true traditional Catholic Church. Most importantly why we drive 45 minutes to attend mass every Sunday here at St Margaret Mary is the homilies that are given by Father Cook are always spot on! We are devoted Catholics and are blessed to be able to travel world wide and we can both agree Father Cooks homilies are second to none. Clear, precise and to the point each and every week. What a blessing he truly is! So happy to be new parishioners of this beautiful place of worship.

This was my parents' parish for 30 years. In the past several years I have been so pleased with the increased reverence inculcated by the last pastor and the current pastor. There are daily confessions before the 8:30 am weekday mass, mass celebrated Ad Orientem, altar rails for Holy Communion, Latin Chant. My mother will have her funeral here next week. Fr Cook provided outstanding spiritual care before her death and the staff was so accommodating. Great things are happening in the Diocese of Charlottte all around, I sense it. St Margaret Mary, ora pro nobis!

This little Catholic church is set back into the picturesque hills. The congregation was warm and friendly. The pastor was passionate in his homily and praying the Mass. The Mass was celebrated with simple hymns, and full participation of the congration. It was a spiritual highlight for us during our visit to this magnificent part of the country.

God is truly present in the Mass in form of Bread He gives us His Body and in form of Wine His true Blood. In His Spirit through our petition and unión with Him He gives Himself to us . This Church has helped me to grow up in love for God. Yes the Mass is Heaven on Earth. We are Blessed with Jesus only He is what I need and through this Church I find Jesus closer to me. I am now aware and in love with my Faith. Father Matt is a gift to our community. God Bless him always for blessing us with Truth. His Spiritual talks are published in the website. Taste and see the goodness of the Lord. Mondays at 7 people are being healed here at the charismatic Mass.
